coverageNotes: INCOMPLETE ROUND: no search-based discovery was done, and no new (non-seed) venues were found. The shared WebSearch budget for the turn (200 calls across all agents) was already used up when this agent started. All six first-round searches were refused with 'web search not performed': 'gym in Kasarani Nairobi', 'gym in Roysambu Nairobi membership', 'gym Zimmerman Nairobi fitness centre', 'gym in Ruaka Kiambu county', 'gym in Thika town contact phone', 'gym in Ruiru Kenya'. The queries array is empty on purpose because none of them ran. I did not retry, and I did not use curl, third-party readers, archives, directories or search-engine pages to get round the limit. I also did not add any venue from memory, because that breaks the hard rules. What I did: read the seed entries for the area (roughly 100 seed venues, some on the edges of the area across Kasarani, Roysambu, Zimmerman, Githurai, Ruaka, Runda, Kiambu, Ruiru, Juja, Thika, Kikuyu), then opened the own websites listed in the seed for those venues with WebFetch. Results: 4 sites gave usable new facts (PAMIA, MDA Studios, Deliberate Fitness blog, Link2Fitness) and 1 low-confidence lead (Kenyatta University sports directorate). All five are inSeed=true. Two of them (PAMIA and MDA Studios) turned out not to be gyms, and Link2Fitness may be online-only. 12 seed websites do not resolve at all (ENOTFOUND), 4 gave HTTP 500, 503 or 404 and are listed in unverifiedLeads so they can be retried. A dead domain is not evidence that a venue is closed, so none of them is marked status=closed. Many of the seed's Kasarani, Githurai, Zimmerman, Ruaka, Thika and Ruiru gyms have only a phone number and no website at all, and I could not check them without search. Nothing could be checked for Runda, Muthaiga, Juja, Limuru, Kiambu town or Thika beyond the seed. Out-of-area observations from pages I opened (not added as candidates): F45 Training Lavington's own page shows 'Naushad Merali Dr' and phone +254 758 583 067 (seed has +254704600845), and Nairobi Jiu-Jitsu Academy's site shows +254 (0) 798 566 294 and nairobijiujitsu@gmail.com, with no street address. Recommended follow-up: re-run this group (and the other groups) once the WebSearch budget is raised or reset, with the estate-by-estate query list from the task, plus hotel, university and club gym queries (Thika Road, Kiambu Road, Ruiru, Juja, Thika, Kikuyu, Limuru).
